recent_excerpts: CVE-2026-114625, a SQL injection in on-prem Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, is now in CISA's KEV catalog with a federal remediation deadline of October 26, 2026.
Canada's Cyber Centre warns CVE-2026-48842, a CVSS 8.1 pre-auth SQL injection in Roundcube's virtuser_query plugin, is being exploited. Fixed in 1.6.16 and 1.7.1.
CISA added CVE-2026-65660, a network-exploitable SharePoint code injection flaw, to its KEV catalog with a 2026-09-28 federal remediation deadline.
